notes.title: June 30th Update Notes
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have received a lot of feedback from the comments section, and we sincerely thank everyone for actively communicating with us and providing valuable opinions and suggestions. We have been closely monitoring the feedback from players and making every effort to address the issues you have encountered.

Now, we would like to inform you about the latest updates:

Bug Fixes:
In this update, we focused on fixing a bug that prevented some players from entering the game. We apologize for the inconvenience it may have caused you and thank you for your patience.

Furthermore, we are delighted to announce that the monster models have been successfully restored to their normal state. Players can once again enjoy the exquisite monster models, adding more fun to your exploration and battles.

New Additions:
We have added some new features to enhance your gaming experience. Based on the feedback from the comments section, we now support adjustable window sizes and have introduced a convenient F10 "boss key" that allows you to quickly hide the game interface when needed.

Currently, we are actively developing and adding more practical and enjoyable features and content to meet your expectations. Our goal is to create a rich and delightful game world for you.

We deeply understand that without your support and feedback, we cannot continuously progress and improve. Therefore, we sincerely thank you for your support and patience. If you have any new ideas or suggestions for the game, we encourage you to continue sharing them in the comments section. Your feedback is crucial to us, and we will consider it seriously and strive to implement it.

Our team is dedicated to providing the best gaming experience and will continue to work hard to ensure the stability and smoothness of the game.
Here is our team's QQ group number: 622522947.Email address：liuliyule@163.com
If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions while playing the game, we encourage you to contact us at any time.

Thank you for your support and understanding of our game. We will continue to work hard to bring you more exciting and enjoyable gaming experiences.

Have a great time playing!

The Development Team at Liuli

notes.title: June 30th Update Notes
notes.content:
Dear players,

We would like to inform you about the latest update on June 30th. In this update, we have temporarily replaced certain monster models and fixed a crash bug.

To ensure a smooth gaming experience, we have taken necessary measures to address the issues with the monster models. These temporary replacements will not affect any combat values or gameplay mechanics.

Furthermore, we have made efforts to fix the crash bug that some players have encountered. The aim of this fix is to improve game stability and provide a more enjoyable gaming environment.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and sincerely appreciate your understanding and support. If you encounter any other issues or have any feedback, please feel free to contact our customer support team.

Thank you for your ongoing support and patience. We will continue to strive for an enhanced gaming experience.

Best regards,

The Development Team at Liuli
